body.name: Legal protocol class \(\Pi(G^{+},\mathcal A)\)
body.construction: \(\Pi(G^{+},\mathcal A)=\{S\subseteq\mathcal A: |S\cap\mathrm{SELECT}|=1,\ S\text{ selects a fresh independent unit},\ S\text{ uses each mechanism at most once},\ S\text{ is precedence closed and conflict free, and }S\text{ satisfies CTF\text{-}REALIZE on }G^{+}\}\).
